moments.person: A parent with children asking what they can eat
moments.setting: The kitchen during the first hour of a neighborhood outage
moments.activity: Keeping dinner and bedtime moving without repeatedly opening the refrigerator
moments.friction: Every check of the refrigerator door lets cold air escape
moments.disruption: The lights and Wi-Fi stop during meal preparation
moments.failure: The family treats the refrigerator like a pantry while deciding what to do
moments.consequence: Food warms faster and uncertainty turns into unnecessary waste
moments.immediate_action: Write a quick eat-first list from memory and keep the refrigerator closed
moments.backup_plan: Move only the most perishable items to a prepared cooler if the outage extends
moments.question: What should the family use first without sacrificing everything else?
moments.false_assumption: Checking the food often helps protect it
moments.curiosity_payoff: A closed refrigerator is already a short-term backup; the first useful tool is a decision list, not another door check
moments.useful_discovery: Choose the next meal before opening the door, then retrieve everything in one trip
visual_evidence: closed refrigerator with a handwritten eat-first list
family using one lamp at the table

requirements: verified refrigerator startup and running load support
product_fit.no_fit_when: No verified runtime or output supports the appliance

moments.person: An adult helping a parent who uses a nightly CPAP
moments.setting: A bedroom before a stormy night
moments.activity: Preparing the normal sleep routine so another family member can handle it
moments.friction: Only one person knows which cord, settings, and backup steps belong together
moments.disruption: That person may be away when power drops
moments.failure: The household owns backup equipment but cannot connect it confidently
moments.consequence: A stressful night becomes a preventable care scramble
moments.immediate_action: Label the CPAP cord and place a one-card handoff beside the machine
moments.backup_plan: Keep the clinician-approved outage instructions and care contact with the setup
moments.question: Could another person run the first five minutes without coaching?
moments.false_assumption: Owning backup power means the care plan is ready
moments.curiosity_payoff: The fragile link is often the handoff, not the hardware
moments.useful_discovery: Rehearse one setup handoff in daylight and record the exact unresolved question for the clinician or equipment provider

product_fit.no_fit_when: The content would imply medical advice or guaranteed runtime

moments.person: A mobile technician finishing the final appointment
moments.setting: A customer driveway near the end of the workday
moments.activity: Documenting completed work and collecting the customer signature
moments.friction: The tablet is at three percent after navigation and photos all day
moments.disruption: The client is ready to sign but no outlet is accessible
moments.failure: The technician plans battery life around driving rather than the last customer action
moments.consequence: A completed job cannot be closed, delaying billing and the next route
moments.immediate_action: Reserve a device power floor for the final signature and upload
moments.backup_plan: Carry a tested cable and compact source assigned to the service bag
moments.question: Which five-minute task actually determines whether the day is finished?
moments.false_assumption: The highest-drain task is always the most important one to protect
moments.curiosity_payoff: A tiny closing task can control the revenue outcome of an entire visit
moments.useful_discovery: Protect the last transaction first, then budget power backward through photos, navigation, and calls
visual_evidence: tablet signature screen at low battery
compact cable kit in a labeled pouch

requirements: portable enough for the service bag
product_fit.no_fit_when: Compatibility with the depicted tablet is unknown

moments.person: A wedding DJ moving from ceremony audio to reception music
moments.setting: A venue lawn with the reception room across the property
moments.activity: Keeping microphones, controller, laptop, and backup music ready during the transition
moments.friction: Every device shows a different battery percentage and the only outlet is inside
moments.disruption: The ceremony runs late and removes the planned recharge window
moments.failure: The plan protects the biggest device but not the microphone receiver needed first
moments.consequence: The first announcement can fail even while the main system has power
moments.immediate_action: Rank devices by the next cue, not by size, and top up the receiver first
moments.backup_plan: Keep one wired microphone and a locally stored emergency playlist ready
moments.question: What is the very next cue the audience cannot miss?
moments.false_assumption: The largest piece of gear deserves power first
moments.curiosity_payoff: Event power is a sequence problem: the next irreplaceable cue outranks total capacity
moments.useful_discovery: Build a cue-order charging list before guests arrive and update it whenever the timeline moves

requirements: verified outputs for the named production gear
quiet operation where audio is recorded
product_fit.no_fit_when: The product could introduce noise or lacks verified compatibility

moments.person: A commuter student finishing a group assignment
moments.setting: A library table forty minutes before the submission deadline
moments.activity: Combining edits, exporting the file, and uploading it through campus Wi-Fi
moments.friction: Everyone watched the laptop percentage but nobody checked whether the phone could approve the login
moments.disruption: The phone dies just as the platform requests multifactor authentication
moments.failure: The group protects creation but not access
moments.consequence: Finished work can miss the deadline despite a charged laptop
moments.immediate_action: Charge the authentication device and confirm offline access before final export
moments.backup_plan: Set up approved backup authentication methods before deadline day
moments.question: Which small device can lock you out of work that is already finished?
moments.false_assumption: Only the laptop battery matters for a digital submission
moments.curiosity_payoff: The smallest device in the workflow may hold the key to the largest one
moments.useful_discovery: Map the whole submission chain: create, authenticate, connect, upload, and confirm

product_fit.no_fit_when: The post can be fully useful without a product

moments.person: A market vendor serving a line near closing time
moments.setting: An outdoor market stall after a full day of card payments
moments.activity: Completing the final sales and sending digital receipts
moments.friction: The card reader was charged, but the phone supplying its connection is nearly dead
moments.disruption: A late rush arrives as neighboring stalls begin packing
moments.failure: The owner treats each device separately instead of protecting the sale as one chain
moments.consequence: Customers with items in hand cannot pay
moments.immediate_action: Put the phone, reader, and hotspot on one closing checklist with minimum charge levels
moments.backup_plan: Prepare an approved offline-payment or cash procedure and visible receipt process
moments.question: What has to stay alive for one more sale to finish?
moments.false_assumption: A charged card reader guarantees checkout
moments.curiosity_payoff: A sale is only as powered as the weakest device between tap and receipt
moments.useful_discovery: Test one complete transaction at the start of the final hour, including connection and receipt delivery

product_fit.no_fit_when: The product cannot support the complete checkout chain

moments.person: A parent traveling alone with two children
moments.setting: An airport concourse after an unexpected gate change
moments.activity: Finding the new gate while keeping boarding passes and family communication available
moments.friction: The nearest charging seats are in the opposite direction from the new gate
moments.disruption: A delay becomes a short connection with repeated app updates
moments.failure: The family waits for a full charge instead of preserving the tasks the phone must still do
moments.consequence: Charging convenience competes with making the flight
moments.immediate_action: Use low-power mode, screenshot boarding passes, and navigate toward the gate
moments.backup_plan: Give one travel companion the itinerary and confirmation details before departure
moments.question: Which phone jobs still matter between this gate and the aircraft door?
moments.false_assumption: A full battery is the goal during a travel disruption
moments.curiosity_payoff: Travel resilience comes from preserving functions, not chasing a percentage
moments.useful_discovery: Name the remaining jobs, secure offline copies, then spend battery only on those jobs

product_fit.no_fit_when: The product distracts from the immediate no-purchase actions

moments.person: Two day hikers returning later than planned
moments.setting: A wooded trail one hour before sunset
moments.activity: Following the marked route back to the trailhead
moments.friction: One phone took every photo and also holds the only downloaded map
moments.disruption: A scenic detour used more daylight and battery than expected
moments.failure: Entertainment and navigation share one unbudgeted device
moments.consequence: The easiest return becomes less certain as visibility drops
moments.immediate_action: Stop taking photos, confirm the route, and put the navigation phone in low-power mode
moments.backup_plan: Carry a separate tested light and share the offline route with both hikers before leaving
moments.question: Which device is doing two jobs that should not fail together?
moments.false_assumption: A day hike does not need a return-light plan
moments.curiosity_payoff: The most useful backup may be separating jobs, not adding capacity
moments.useful_discovery: Before the trail, assign navigation, photos, and light to separate reserves whenever possible
visual_evidence: headlamp removed from pack before dark
trailhead return time written on map

product_fit.no_fit_when: Product placement would imply safety is guaranteed

moments.person: A parent waiting in the school pickup line
moments.setting: A parked car on a cold afternoon
moments.activity: Waiting with accessories running before the drive home
devices_and_jobs: seat heaters and blower provide comfort
moments.friction: The engine is off while multiple accessories remain on
moments.disruption: Pickup runs much later than usual
moments.failure: A routine wait quietly consumes the reserve needed to start
moments.consequence: The car may not start when children are finally released
moments.immediate_action: Turn off nonessential loads and start the vehicle according to local rules before reserve becomes uncertain
moments.backup_plan: Keep a charged, vehicle-compatible jump starter and know its safe connection procedure
moments.question: Which comfort loads are borrowing from the one job the battery must still perform?
moments.false_assumption: Accessories use too little power to matter during a long wait
moments.curiosity_payoff: A car battery can support many small comforts until the moment it cannot perform its single critical job
moments.useful_discovery: Treat an unexpectedly long parked wait as a new operating condition, not more of the same routine
visual_evidence: dashboard accessories active with engine off

requirements: verified compatibility with vehicle voltage and engine class

moments.person: A renter assembling furniture on move-in night
moments.setting: A new apartment with boxes covering the floor
moments.activity: Building the bed before the hardware store closes
moments.friction: The driver battery fits the tool but has not been charged since the last move
moments.disruption: The overhead light in the bedroom does not work
moments.failure: Every useful item is somewhere in an unlabeled box
moments.consequence: A simple build becomes a late-night floor search and an unfinished place to sleep
moments.immediate_action: Create one move-in working box with light, charged tool, cable, tape, and basic hand tools
moments.backup_plan: Keep the manual tool and printed or downloaded instructions with the hardware
moments.question: What six items let the first room become usable before everything is unpacked?
moments.false_assumption: Owning the tools means they will be available during the move
moments.curiosity_payoff: The best move-in kit is organized around the first completed room, not by product category
moments.useful_discovery: Pack a single first-finish box and label it by outcome: make one room usable

requirements: verified tool charging or lighting capability

moments.person: A neighbor coordinating check-ins after a severe storm
moments.setting: An apartment building lobby with intermittent cell service
moments.activity: Confirming who is safe and which residents need practical help
devices_and_jobs: radio or in-person runner carries updates
moments.friction: All updates live in one group chat that some older residents do not use
moments.disruption: Cell service becomes unreliable while elevators are unavailable
moments.failure: The communication method excludes the people most likely to need a check
moments.immediate_action: Turn the resident list into named check-in pairs and mark status on paper
moments.backup_plan: Choose a physical update point and scheduled check times
moments.question: Who disappears from the plan when the group chat stops working?
moments.false_assumption: Sending a message is the same as confirming contact
moments.curiosity_payoff: A resilient check-in system records the reply, not the attempt
moments.useful_discovery: Assign every person a checker, a second route, and a visible status mark
visual_evidence: paper resident list with confirmed boxes

product_fit.no_fit_when: Always; the useful center is a human coordination practice

moments.person: Friends hosting a backyard movie night
moments.activity: Starting the film after guests have settled
moments.friction: The picture was tested indoors but the full outdoor chain was never rehearsed
moments.disruption: The Wi-Fi signal is weak where the screen looks best
moments.failure: The host troubleshoots streaming while everyone waits in silence
moments.consequence: The social moment loses momentum before the opening scene
moments.immediate_action: Run one full scene outdoors with the exact power, signal, picture, and audio path
moments.backup_plan: Download the film legally for offline playback and keep a wired audio option
moments.question: What changes when the same devices move twenty feet outside?
moments.false_assumption: Testing each device separately proves the experience works
moments.curiosity_payoff: A setup succeeds as a chain in its real location, not as a collection of working devices indoors
moments.useful_discovery: Test the handoffs between source, signal, image, and sound where guests will actually sit

product_fit.no_fit_when: The product is not rated for the depicted environment
